The first is "Full Automation" - by integrating with the proprietary API Fundio, which usually takes 7 to 14 working days. All functions used in the process are automatically initiated from the level of the ERP system (e.g. SAP), and information about invoices is automatically sent to the platform. Such a variant on the Payee's side requires a minimum level of employee involvement, which means that the Payee does not need to dedicate any additional people to operate the program, or introduce special verification procedures. In the second "Quick Start" variant, the program implementation is performed using a file exchange protocol, but with the same high security levels as in the first variant.
